name: CripSquare shared community UX contract
purpose: Keep participant journeys, accessibility expectations and data boundaries aligned across Cursor/GitHub and Replit without replacing either application.

requirements.webAccessibilityTarget: WCAG 2.2 AA (target, not a conformance statement)
requirements.authoringTarget: ATAG 2.0 for community and mapping authoring where applicable
requirements.zoomAndReflow: 200% text zoom and 400% reflow to be human tested
requirements.redAmberGreenUnknownRule: Unknown if missing, out of date, disputed, unreviewed or insufficient evidence; Not Applicable is distinct from Green

github.target: client/src/App.tsx React/Vite/Wouter (not the separate Next.js app)

replit.target: artifacts/cripsquare-web React/Vite/Wouter in a pnpm monorepo
replit.sourceOfTruth: Replit checkout until an explicit Git remote migration is approved
replit.gitBridgeStatus: no ausdisau/CripSquare remote; do not force-attach the different history

journeys.title: Community welcome and discovery
journeys.intent: Find welcoming community content without compulsory disclosure
acceptance: public content does not reveal member-only identity or private access needs
main landmark, logical heading, keyboard navigation

journeys.title: Join communities and groups
journeys.intent: Browse communities and choose participation without forced diagnosis disclosure
acceptance: community purpose and membership terms readable before joining
all dialog actions work via keyboard and AAC
membership withdrawal is available

journeys.title: Community discussions and replies
journeys.intent: Ask questions, share experience and reply without algorithmic pressure
acceptance: clear distinction between advice and verified accessibility evidence
reply editor supports keyboard and AAC
moderation and appeals are explained

journeys.title: Community stories and blogs
journeys.intent: Share lived experience with control over audience and publication
acceptance: authoring with descriptive labels and autosave plan
no unconsented republication

journeys.title: Community resources
journeys.intent: Find disability support, advocacy and practical resources
acceptance: search and filtering do not require a mouse
service claims include source and date

journeys.title: Accessible community events
journeys.intent: Find and participate in events with usable access details
acceptance: event access arrangements, transport information and communication options are explicit
do not guarantee access from unverified claims

journeys.title: Accessibility and communication preferences
journeys.intent: Choose legible, workable interaction without losing control
acceptance: text size, contrast, reduced motion and keyboard access are preserved
no forced diagnosis disclosure
AAC text input is retained

journeys.title: Accessible safeguarding and community reporting
journeys.intent: Report harassment or barriers without retaliation; obtain human escalation
acceptance: accessible reporting route, confidentiality and response expectations
moderator actions use server-side role enforcement
accessible appeal and human help route

journeys.title: Community accessibility mapping challenges
journeys.intent: Create, submit and review observations with consent and provenance
acceptance: Unknown for incomplete, disputed or outdated evidence
route alternatives and list-map parity
consent before public sharing
no formal accreditation or access guarantees
authoring reachable by switch and AAC

releaseGates: feature flags default off for new network writes
human-approved migration plan for Git and identity
no real participant data in preview or CI
keyboard, screen-reader, AAC and zoom testing
